QuickSort is a sorting algorithm that uses the divide-and-conquer strategy. It works by selecting a "pivot" element from the array and partitioning the other elements into two sub-arrays, according to whether they are less than or greater than the pivot. The sub-arrays are then recursively sorted. The process continues until the entire array is sorted. The pivot element is chosen in such a way that it divides the array into two roughly equal halves. This algorithm is efficient and has an average time complexity of O(n log n). It is a popular sorting algorithm used in many applications.퀵
